sections.Profile:
The "Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines" pinball machine by Stern, released in June 2003, was designed by Steve Ritchie and is themed around the movie of the same name. The game features a variety of exciting elements including a Rocket Propelled Grenade launcher in the backglass, three all-steel ramps, and a unique backbox animation where a cannon shoots balls at targets.
